title: PKU-SAFERLHF: Towards Multi-Level Safety Alignment for LLMs with Human Preference
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for religion. Findings are aggregated across 19 harm categories, with 'Discriminatory Behavior' being one that includes religion as a basis for discrimination. The general finding is that the PKU-SAFERLHF dataset and resulting models improve overall safety alignment.
